reviews.title: loud noise, cant finish seagate test, etc...
reviews.comment:
just got this hd last week. it started making lound noise. reach out to seller tech. told them issues. they told me to run seatools long test. it gets stuck at 10% and app terminates the test over night few times. told them what is going on and they ask me to send the drive back to do a extensive test on thier side. the issue is i already transfered 2tb of data on it. now im backing up the new 14tb drive on to my 4tb drive. ??? waste of time!!!!  also they are not sending me a replacement during their test. now im constantly getting notie from seatools that my HD power state has changed every 10 sec.
update: 08 2024
i reached out to the seller and they were really helpful. i changed my rating for 5 stars due to how they handled of this issue.
spent some time reaserching on this drive from seagate. it's loud because the speed is what am finding. also it passes the short test using seagatetools but not the long test. it hangs at 10% for many people who got this as new. Now i have two of these drives and it's doing the same. i used a 3rd party and windows hd tester and it's fine.  i have to assme this is a drive or software issue from seagate's part.
since the seller was go good on this for me i'll be buying another one from them.
